scientific_scope: Cross-protein nonsynonymous Boel function prediction; a development-selected mechanism-channel screen, not fixed-protein synonymous mechanism evidence, functional-untouched confirmation, velocity validation, generator authorization, or SOTA.

screen.selection_metric: dev cluster_balanced_mse independently recomputed from predictions
screen.selection_rule: Select exactly one arm: minimum dev cluster-balanced MSE; exact ties resolved by arms_in_tie_break_order.
screen.checkpoint_rule: Existing frozen training script selects each arm checkpoint by minimum dev cluster_balanced_mse; no test/OOD rows are loaded by the screen configs.

evaluation.trigger: Only after channel_screen_selection_v1.json is PASS_CHANNEL_SELECTION_FROZEN and its SHA256 is recorded.
evaluation.selected_checkpoint_rule: Evaluation-run best state_dict and train/dev predictions must be bitwise identical to the screen run; otherwise evaluation aborts.
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm across six comparisons within each partition
evaluation.channel_gate: All six sequence-OOD comparisons favor the selected arm: Spearman CI95 low>0 or CB-MSE CI95 high<0, and Holm p<0.05.
evaluation.overall_gate: rk_g1_pass remains false regardless of this screen because velocity_mechanism_pass=false and functional untouched is not evaluated.

prior_checkpoint_equivalence.requirement: The train/dev-only all and none state_dicts must be bitwise equal to these prior runs, empirically confirming that excluded rows did not affect training.
